description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English
The unique ID of the gateway.

description.zh:
获取指定服务来源类型（为空返回所有类型）：
- 容器服务：K8s
- MSE Nacos：MSE
- MSE ZooKeeper：MSE_ZK
- SAE 注册中心：SAE
- EDAS 注册中心：EDAS
description.en:
Specifies the type of the returned service source. If this parameter is not specified, service sources of all types are returned. Valid values:

- K8s: Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) instance.

- MSE Nacos: MSE

- MSE ZooKeeper: MSE\_ZK

- SAE: SAE

- EDAS: EDAS

title.zh: 查询网关已关联的服务来源列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse list-service-source --gateway-unique-id gw-c51a15c7ee934a4fb945ccf35fe10000 --source MSE --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse ListServiceSource --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-c51a15c7ee934a4fb945ccf35fe10000' --AcceptLanguage zh --Source MSE
